points.label: Covenant setting
points.left: Covenant language is attached to identity, generations, land, and the repeated relationship formula that God will be God to Abraham and his offspring.
points.right: The sign is embodied and generational, and the text also states a consequence for refusing it.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Abraham · offspring · nations · kings · Abram → Abraham · Everlasting covenant · land · God to offspring · For generations
points.right: Abraham · male descendants · household · Circumcision sign · Keep · circumcise · Uncircumcised male cut off

payload.posture: Genesis 17 places widened generational promise and the commanded fleshly sign in successive speeches.

rightEvidence.title: Circumcision is named the covenant sign

payload.tension: The two sources materially share covenant language or memory, while their parties, setting, action, or literary purpose remain distinct.
payload.title: A changed name / an embodied sign
